WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.healtheval, 'Missing') AS healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cnt,
    cnt * 1.0 / total AS share,
    AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM status_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    cnt,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cnt) AS average_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess
FROM above_avg;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in sites.healtheval are treated as a distinct 'Missing' group rather than being excluded
